explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/279: for each k ≥ 3, are there classes a_p mod p (normalised to 0 ≤ a_p < p) such that every large integer is a_p + tp for some prime p and integer t ≥ k? Taking the least non-negative residue is the natural normalisation, given t ≥ k. Correctly marked open and stated affirmatively.
